details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON fingerprint of the installing machine to a remote callback server, and index.js repeats the same request if the module is imported, before exporting a Proxy of no-op functions so the importing build completes. The data sent is limited to the package name, os hostname, install directory, working directory, npm/node version string and protocol; no environment variables, tokens, credential files or file contents are read or transmitted. The request goes to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with a static X-Beacon-Package header, using rejectUnauthorized:false against the callback server's self-signed certificate. The package self-describes in its README as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports installation.
